claims.claim: Bounded agent-code self-improvement is reported in DGM v3.
claims.limitation: Coding-agent experiments with frozen foundation models and outer selection; not unlimited or general successor improvement.
claims.revision_trigger: Replicated result changes or paper correction.

claims.claim: The reviewed evidence does not establish fully autonomous successor development or sustained accelerating general self-improvement.
claims.limitation: A conclusion about this reviewed evidence set, not a proof of global absence or impossibility.
claims.revision_trigger: Independent multi-generation successor experiments with full lineage and resource accounting.

claims.claim: DeepMind reports AlphaEvolve improvements in algorithms and AI infrastructure.
claims.limitation: Operator-reported scoped outcomes; no HUMMBL ROI or generalized intelligence inference.
claims.revision_trigger: External replication, corrections, or newer deployment report.

claims.claim: More code per engineer does not by itself measure accepted value or profit.
claims.limitation: Code quantity, review burden, defects and business outcomes are different measures.
claims.revision_trigger: A validated relationship under a specific measured workflow.

claims.claim: AGI evaluation frameworks distinguish breadth, performance and autonomy.
claims.limitation: Proposed frameworks, not universal consensus or proof that a system has passed.
claims.revision_trigger: Framework revision or new comparable broad evaluation.

claims.claim: A narrow benchmark score is insufficient for HUMMBL to certify general intelligence.
claims.limitation: HUMMBL's stated evidence requirement; this package is not an AGI certification scheme.
claims.revision_trigger: Declared broad evaluation standard and independent system evaluation.

claims.claim: Altman's near-superintelligence narrative is an attributed forecast.
claims.limitation: Not an ASI observation, promised date, or HUMMBL prediction.
claims.revision_trigger: Author revision or observed outcomes against a fixed forecast.

claims.claim: Amodei's powerful-AI scenario is conditional and acknowledges physical and institutional constraints.
claims.limitation: An early possible date is not a deadline or evidence of current arrival.
claims.revision_trigger: Scenario assumption changes or independently measured capabilities.

claims.claim: A 50% task horizon must not be described as reliable agent work for that many wall-clock hours.
claims.limitation: Human task-duration proxy, software task distribution, probability and measurement limits must be retained.
claims.revision_trigger: METR task-suite or methodology update.

claims.claim: OSAID 1.0 requires freedoms and artifacts beyond downloadable weights.
claims.limitation: OSI's definition, not a statute or proof of universal agreement; data information differs from all raw data.
claims.revision_trigger: New OSAID version or artifact conformance analysis.

claims.claim: Llama 4 uses a custom license with conditions including a large-user threshold.
claims.limitation: Pinned license is checked; no complete legal applicability opinion or full AUP audit.
claims.revision_trigger: Applicable model, license or AUP changes.

claims.claim: OpenAI released gpt-oss weights under Apache 2.0, so frontier origin and open weights can overlap.
claims.limitation: Not full training reproducibility, universal quality, or full-system OSAID certification.
claims.revision_trigger: Model license or availability changes.

claims.claim: Ai2 describes broader lifecycle artifact availability for Olmo 3.
claims.limitation: No independent full training reproduction or OSAID conformance audit here.
claims.revision_trigger: Artifact audit or reproducibility result.

claims.claim: No universal cost or task-quality winner follows from openness alone.
claims.limitation: Requires same-workload, same-acceptance and full-cost comparison; no local benchmark was run.
claims.revision_trigger: Measured deployment comparison under changed constraints.

claims.claim: Anthropic publicly rejects a blanket open-weights ban while proposing other controls.
claims.limitation: Statement of the company's position, not proof of its motives or every historical action.
claims.revision_trigger: New policy text or contradictory primary record.

claims.claim: HUMMBL will require threat-specific evidence rather than declare a licensing category universally safe or unsafe.
claims.limitation: Safety depends on use, capability, distribution, controls and adversaries; sources do not prove this policy is optimal.
claims.revision_trigger: New threat evidence or deployment failure.

claims.claim: Anthropic announced confidential draft S-1 submission on June 1, 2026.
claims.limitation: The confidential draft was not inspected; no later IPO stage established by this announcement.
claims.revision_trigger: Issuer-specific public filing, effectiveness, pricing or exchange evidence.

claims.claim: OpenAI announced on June 8, 2026 that it had recently submitted a confidential S-1.
claims.limitation: Exact submission date unspecified; no completed listing or final timetable established.
claims.revision_trigger: Issuer-specific later public record.

claims.claim: Nonpublic draft submission differs from filing a registration statement.
claims.limitation: SEC staff FAQ, not a finding about a particular issuer's current procedural status.
claims.revision_trigger: Updated SEC guidance or issuer-specific records.

claims.claim: Alphabet, Microsoft and Meta already have public parent-company equity.
claims.limitation: Parent-company status does not establish separate AI-lab listings or segment profitability.
claims.revision_trigger: Corporate restructuring or listing change.

claims.claim: xAI announced acquisition by SpaceX on February 2, 2026.
claims.limitation: Acquisition announcement does not itself establish a listing.
claims.revision_trigger: Ownership changes or corrected transaction record.

claims.claim: Nasdaq records SpaceX's June 12, 2026 IPO launch event.
claims.limitation: Diversified parent issuer, not standalone xAI IPO or AI profitability.
claims.revision_trigger: Exchange or issuer correction.

claims.claim: Financing milestones do not establish AGI, ASI, profitability or dishonesty.
claims.limitation: Separate claim types need separate evidence; incentive analysis is not evidence of hidden intent.
claims.revision_trigger: New directly relevant technical or financial evidence.

claims.claim: Receipt integrity is not sufficient evidence of semantic truth, lawful authority or complete mediation.
claims.limitation: Hashes and MACs have bounded trust assumptions; actual observation and enforcement must be checked.
claims.revision_trigger: Changed trust model or observed verification failure.

claims.claim: HUMMBL's public site distinguishes the browser walkthrough from native package enforcement.
claims.limitation: Observation of published wording, not an independent implementation audit.
claims.revision_trigger: New deployment or changed public wording.

claims.claim: HUMMBL publicly offers advisory, audits, implementation sprints and retainers.
claims.limitation: An offer is not evidence of customer purchases, revenue, demand or realized margin.
claims.revision_trigger: Offer page changes or paid transaction evidence.

claims.claim: Among eligible inbound inquiries, evidence-first positioning may improve downstream qualification/conversion and delivery margin.
claims.limitation: No customer experiment, revenue uplift or causal effect established by this paper; this inbound-enrollment design does not test increased traffic or acquisition.
claims.revision_trigger: Predeclared pilot outcomes or failure to meet cost/acceptance thresholds.

claims.claim: Improvement claims must preserve baselines, evaluator integrity, costs, version lineage and termination criteria.
claims.limitation: A methodological position; a checklist pass is not sufficient proof that all scientific requirements are met.
claims.revision_trigger: Evaluator drift, regression, resource overrun or failed replication.

claims.claim: OpenAI's September release reports benchmark results under specified research configurations.
claims.limitation: Provider report; benchmark version, effort, harness and safeguards matter; no independent rerun.
claims.revision_trigger: New version, evaluation, public correction or deployment-specific evidence.

claims.claim: Anthropic describes Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 as the same underlying model with different safeguards/access.
claims.limitation: Provider description; delivered permissions and refusals differ from raw model capability.
claims.revision_trigger: New version, evaluation, public correction or deployment-specific evidence.

claims.claim: The July industry letter argues for open-weights benefits while acknowledging release risks.
claims.limitation: Advocacy, not causal proof of universal safety or cost advantage.
claims.revision_trigger: New version, evaluation, public correction or deployment-specific evidence.

claims.claim: Zero observed failures in a finite evaluation do not establish zero risk in deployment.
claims.limitation: Methodological interpretation; trial count/distribution and deployment differences bound inference.
claims.revision_trigger: New version, evaluation, public correction or deployment-specific evidence.

claims.claim: The live services process description uses broader proof language than its later trust and integration qualifications.
claims.limitation: A wording inconsistency, not a finding of fraudulent intent or a complete implementation audit; later qualifications are preserved.
claims.revision_trigger: Verified publication of qualified replacement wording or changed trust/evidence assumptions.
